sql.label: webhooks
sql.query: SELECT id::text, is_active::text FROM webhooks ORDER BY id::text

sql.label: webhook_logs
sql.query: SELECT webhook::text, COALESCE(event_type, 'NULL'), COALESCE(request_method, 'NULL'), COALESCE(response_status, 'NULL'), COALESCE(response_headers, 'NULL'), COALESCE(response_body, 'NULL'), retry_count::text FROM webhook_logs ORDER BY webhook::text, retry_count

normalize.pattern: ^(?:\('Connection aborted\.', RemoteDisconnected\('Remote end closed connection without response'\)\)|error sending request for url \(http://127\.0\.0\.1:\d+/hook-one\))$
